text:
carol_sales (Sales): NorthWind wants a 10-day POC for a custom variant they call 'orca-edge-12b-hf-q5b'. Ask: reserved pricing for ~1.05M tokens/mo, Dedicated A100 compatibility, session persistent KV cache, and Private VPC with BYO-KMS. Looping in @ben_ml @harper_ops @sida_sec.

ben_ml (Eng-ML): Quick clarifier: was the model exported with any fused-attention or custom CUDA kernels? If yes we need the unfused checkpoint or the fused-op sources. Also what's their p95 latency target and avg prompt/response lengths?

carol_sales (Sales): They want p95 <= 280ms for short queries. Typical prompts ~28 tokens, responses ~150 tokens. They said export used an "HF optimize" step which may fuse ops; they're checking if they can share the original export flags.

ben_ml (Eng-ML): HF optimize fusions sometimes inline fused attention or RMSNorm variants. If fused ops are present and not standard, we may fallback to a compatible kernel, which can add latency. For staging I'd run q5b/int8 paths with prefix_session KV cache. Example smoke config I'd try on Dedicated: ```yaml
model: orca-edge-12b-hf-q5b
precision: q5b
hardware: a100-80gb
batching:
  max_tokens_per_batch: 6144
  latency_target_ms: 260
kv_cache: prefix_session_persistent
sequence_max: 2048
```

harper_ops (Solutions): For pricing: reserved pool + effective per-token depends on utilization and KV hit rate. For this variant on A100, a practical estimate is $0.0035 to $0.009 per 1k tokens on reserved (lower bound assumes >70% cache/batch hit). I'll produce a formal calc after perf numbers.

sida_sec (Security): BYO-KMS + Private VPC supported. We'll need their KMS key ARN, key policy, rotation cadence, and completed security questionnaire. Also ask whether they require audit log forwarding to a customer SIEM. If they plan to send regulated data escalate to compliance.

ben_ml (Eng-ML): Request they upload: 1) model wheel or checkpoint, 2) export flags (hf-optimize command), 3) small validation set (30-50 prompts), and 4) a 24h concurrency trace or peak conc estimate. If fused ops are present, we may ask for the training repo commit and CUDA/cuDNN versions to reproduce.

carol_sales (Sales): I'll ask them for the artifacts. They said they can provide the checkpoint and export flags, and can share a 48-hour trace. I'll push for the validation prompts too.

harper_ops (Solutions): Operational note: session-persistent KV cache hit rate materially affects cost. If their workload reuses prefixes heavily, effective per-token cost drops substantially. Also burst shape matters for pool sizing; if bursts >100 concurrent short requests we'll need larger pool headroom.

sida_sec (Security): Also clarify retention window and whether they want logs forwarded. For BYO-KMS we provide an IAM policy template; they should confirm cross-account access needs.

deploy-bot: Ticket POC-9007 created: "northwind-poc-staging" assigned to eng-ml and eng-infra. ETA: 72h. :wrench:

ben_ml (Eng-ML): Once artifacts are in I'll run a perf + quality smoke on a staging A100. If HF optimize fused any nonstandard ops we may either: 1) ask for unfused checkpoint, or 2) run compat test and possibly trigger a small runtime rebuild (adds ~2-4 business days). I'll post results and any kernel fallbacks.

harper_ops (Solutions): After Ben's perf report I'll produce a reserved pool recommendation and an estimated effective per-token quote within 48h.

carol_sales (Sales): Thanks all — I'll post uploads here when NorthWind replies and mark the security questionnaire high priority. :rocket:
